summary.text: Tang Fang Ming is Tang clan's number one genius Gu Immortal and the main force behind the clan's dream realm exploration, later trapped in Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable's dream realm.

claims.text: Tang clan’s number one genius Gu Immortal takes the clan mission to explore a dream realm and suffers a great loss, remaining lost in that dream. His sister Tang Miao tries many times to save him and fails. The dream is Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable’s dream realm.

Among Tang clan’s many Gu Immortals, only he suits creative dream realm work. A dozen or so dream path mortal Gu are mostly his creation, and he is the main force behind Tang clan’s dream realm exploration. With him trapped, Tang clan’s progress in that research comes to a halt.

His body stays intact under the clan Gu Immortals’ protection, but his soul has left the body inside the dream and vanished. Once trapped in the dream realm, the soul weakens continuously until death. Guts Gu is the method that can preserve his life. Tang clan buys the remaining market supply at huge cost after the seller ignores richer offers, and ordinary soul strengthening methods can no longer keep up with how fast his soul weakens. Without guts Gu, he would die in his dream.

He and Tang Miao were stripped of status and abandoned when young, survived hardship, and returned after a fortuitous encounter made him a Gu Immortal while she reached rank five peak stage. Tang clan mediated, sacrificed a band of mortal higher-ups, and obtained his return. He then used clan help to raise Tang Miao into a Gu Immortal.

Tang Fang Ming and a second young Tang clan Gu Immortal greet Fang Yuan as he returns from the River of Time, and Tang Fang Ming carefully checks the Immortal Gu Fang Yuan borrowed before storing them. He apologises for the care he takes, saying he borrowed these Gu from the clan personally and that it is a huge responsibility.

In the five hundred years of Fang Yuan’s previous life, Tang Fang Ming becomes extremely famous during the five regions chaotic war, almost the equal of Western Desert’s Ma Hong Yun, with Shadow Sect secretly steering his and Tang clan’s rise. In this life the five regions chaotic war has not started, and Tang clan, which uncovered Thieving Heaven’s dream realm early and keeps it secret, is clueless about dream path, so what slow progress it has rests on Tang Fang Ming’s talent and ingenuity. Even so he nearly dies inside that dream realm, and lives only because his sister gives up her clues to Paradise Earth’s true inheritance to win the help of White Sea Shatuo, a split soul of Spectral Soul.
When Fang Yuan’s first attempt to explore Thieving Heaven’s dream realm fails and he crushes guts Gu to heal his badly injured soul, Tang Fang Ming watches with a look of envy.

Tang Fang Ming, who can barely buy guts Gu himself since supply runs below demand, watches Fang Yuan use it as casually as candy and privately calls him the sole guts Gu seller. Tang Fang Ming has explored and researched this dream realm hundreds or even a thousand times, and his accumulated achievements are not even a fraction of what Fang Yuan gains in one exploration, which leaves him ashamed yet even more admiring of Fang Yuan.
